description:
Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.

Ask for dinner ideas and get recipes from your own library, or branch out with new recipes from Deglaze's discovery database and save the keepers to your library. Browse results as recipe cards with photos, tap through to the full recipe, or create a new recipe in the conversation from family favorites, ingredients you mention, or an idea ChatGPT helps develop.

Then turn ideas into action: put recipes on your meal plan, add their ingredients to your grocery list while skipping items you tell it to omit, and manage the list as you shop. Deglaze uses your preferences and cooking history to steer around allergies, lean into the flavors your household likes, and suggest meals without repeating recent dinners.

defaultPrompt: Find Spring favorites from my saved recipes that I haven't made recently.
Build a meal plan for the week built around a spicy mac & cheese recipe.
